findingsClosed: Missing renderer ACK is bounded, counted as a failed sample, and written to a report before the benchmark exits nonzero.
Benchmark evidence accurately states that an isolated Electron process was launched.
Failure reports can be written to a validated JSON filename under docs/evidence/T01 without replacing the passing baseline.
acceptedScope: Metadata-only timing recorder and no-input wake component baseline.
Synthetic selection timeline schema distinguishes SendInput ACK from target-display observation without reading or writing the system clipboard or sending input.
deferredGates: Successful helper/selection path and actual controlled-editor display are not measured by T01; validate in T03/T05.
Physical hotkey and end-to-end wake latency remain unmeasured; do not claim G0 performance acceptance from the component baseline.
